parameters.name: EntityIdPrefix
parameters.description: The prefix of the sample ID. The prefix can contain digits, letters, and underscores.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: The custom labels. A maximum of 10 labels are supported. Separate multiple labels with commas (,).

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of samples to display per page. Valid values: 1 to 200.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: The start record. Valid values: 0 to 2000.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:
- asc: ascending order.
- desc: descending order.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: When the query results exceed 2000 records, use the Token returned from the previous request as a parameter to query the next page.
